balls.text: Jansen takes it at long-off!! SRH can't touch 240. Vyshak bowled a slower delivery, and on a hittable length outside off. But all Klaasen could do was balloon it up miles in the air. Jansen moves forward and takes it low to restrict SRH to 235
four to fine leg. Not a great line when fine leg is inside the circle. On a length on leg, and the ball angles across, but Klaasen swipes it to the boundary
good bowling. Another yorker. This arrives just outside off at 137kph, and Klaasen squeezes it down the ground to long-off. Quick running gives them two
bang!! Nearly into the second tier. He just goes through the line, and it looks beautiful. A length delivery outside off, and Klaasen eases it over extra cover
superb execution. A yorker a little wide of off, and Klaasen can only jam his bat at that. That hits the bottom edge
a single to start. Reddy is frustrated with himself. It was a length delivery around seventh stump, and Reddy only heaved it to deep square leg off the inside half of the bat
there's a man out at deep third. Reddy reaches out for this wide yorker outside off, and ends up flashing it off the outside edge
just a single to deep midwicket. A low full toss outside off, and Klaasen goes low to swipe. The ball seemed too low for him to have a proper swing at it
between the umpire's legs!! He leaps, and survives. A bouncer from Arsh outside off, and Klaasen advances down and swats it back for two
shapes for the scoop... but ends up playing the reverse sweep!! It's a full toss on leg, and Reddy eventually sends the ball towards deep point
between short third and point. Not very cleanly hit, but still four. Reddy reaches out at this wide yorker which is close to the wide line, and gets it off the outside half of the bat
goes for the wide yorker. The ball angles yorker, and arrives on an eighth-stump line. Klaasen throws his bat at it, but the ball rolls off the bottom edge to short third
finally comes the six in this over. How could it not come, after all?! Slower ball on a short of a length from Ferguson, and Reddy swings at it to go over midwicket
bouncer followed by a yorker. And a quick one. This is fired on leg at 142kph, and Klaasen drills it down to long-on
another bouncer, and at a lack of pace. Wide called. Ferguson bangs it outside leg, and the ball ends over Klaasen's head as he looked to tennis-bat it away
two more. Good running. A bouncer climbing on middle, and he swats it to wide long-on
dot ball. Klaasen curses himself. He made room, and Ferguson went on a length well outside leg. All Klaasen could do was drive to the man at mid-off
slower ball, and full on middle and off. A gentle nudge to deep midwicket... and they push for two. Good running. That's also Klaasen's fifty off 32 balls
he runs in almost diagonally. The ball is fullish length outside off, and pushed to long-on
short again, pulled again... but for two this time. Klaasen takes it from leg, and finds the gap between deep-backward square leg and deep midwicket
now on the bounce to the man at deep midwicket. Another short delivery outside off, and Reddy gives it his all in pulling at that
short delivery on middle. Swat-pulled to deep midwicket as the balls seams away to finish outside off
shot!! Normal service resumes after two quiet overs. Jansen bowls on a length on leg, and Klaasen gets his front leg out of the way to heave that over midwicket
on the bounce to long-on. Short, slow, and wide of off from Jansen. Reddy pulls again, but can't clear Iyer at long-on, as he moves to his right
six!! What a sound off the bat. Short in length just outside off, and seaming in. Reddy read the movement, and swivelled to dump the ball over square leg
very full and quick. Nearly a yorker on the stumps, and driven to deep midwicket
not a good ball. Chahal floats this on his Reddy's pads, and the latter sweeps off this full length to fine leg. The man out was only at deep square leg
slower one again. This is on a short of a length, and dips on leg. Klaasen backs away, and pulls with the turn to long-on
much slower now. Chahal is doing well. Length ball on leg, and nudged towards midwicket
short and quick from Chahal, and only a single for Klaasen. He bowls this just outside leg, and Klaasen backs away to punch to long-off
dot ball to start with. Tossed up, and full on leg. Klaasen switch hits to the man at cover point
very full, and floated on the stumps. Whipped to deep midwicket
shorter side of a length, and wide of off. It angles in, and Reddy punches to deep cover point

taken!! Finally. Shedge is at deep square leg. PBKS hold on to a catch after what seems like a day. Arsh bowled short to Kishan as well, and one at a lack of pace. Kishan shifted his weight back and went hard for the pull. But there was the longer boundary there, and Shedge did well to move to his left and grab it
Arsh switches to the short ball for Klaasen. This pitches on middle, and shapes away. Swatted to long-on by Klaasen
another yorker-length ball. This is good stuff from Arsh. This ball swings in to arrive on off, and is drilled to long-on from deep in the crease
good ball. But it's also good running. A yorker from Arsh, who swings the ball well in, and bowls outside leg after seeing Kishan make room. Kishan clips it towards square leg for a hurried two
tries the cheeky sweep, but misses out on a big hit. The ball is full and very wide of off, and Kishan reaches out. But he gets a bottom edge on to his leg
the biggest of the three!! Fifty off 28 balls for Kishan. Kishan hangs deep in the crease, and launches at this length delivery - yet again. This one travels over wide long-on
down the ground now!! Vyshak looks helpless. He bowls another slower ball, but this is on a length and wide of off. Kishan has enough room for a liberal swing of the bat
pulled over fine leg!! This time Kishan reads the slower and short ball. In fact, it's the knuckle ball. The ball rises on middle, and Kishan swivels to pull
Klaasen backs away, and Vyshak follows. He bowls on a length, and well outside leg. Klaasen again looked to whip but got hit on the pad. The ball rolled to short fine leg
nearly a yorker just outside off. Kishan hoicks it to long-on

ruins the over for Jansen!! Klaasen even holds the pose. This just clears the boundary down the ground. A length delivery from Jansen, and this one angles across to arrive wide of off. Klaasen gets the length and the room to dispatch that
another short ball. Jansen has banged a number of those in this over. This is slow, and around seventh stump. Kishan pulls to deep square leg
Klaasen misses out to score off this one. Jansen bowls full and just outside leg, and a slower one again. Klaasen looked to flick hard, but the ball trickled off his pad to short fine leg
a slower bouncer this time. Wide of off from Jansen, and Kishan reaches out to slash awkwardly towards cover point
wide outside leg. Slower ball from Jansen, but the line is incorrect. He pitches it on a length on leg, and the ball slides down as Kishan looked to swipe but missed
pulled wide of long-on. Two more for Kishan. Short from Jansen, and wide-ish of off. Kishan swats it away
angles it across, and bowls on a short of a length on middle. Punched to long-off
another short delivery just outside off. Klaasen rides the bounce, and rolls his wrists to pull to deep square leg
slower ball now. Short of a length, and around off. Kishan adjusts for the lack of bounce for this ball at 113kph, and pulls to long leg
another length delivery. This is on the stumps, and Klaasen punched it to long-on
a length delivery angling across, and pitching around off. Swung down to long-on
knuckle ball. A bouncer outside off, and swat-pulled to deep square leg
past the man at short third. A late slash off a short-of-a-length ball in the corridor outside off, and beats the fielder to his right

missed stumping!! Chahal can't believe his eyes. But he would himself say Prabh had a tough chance. Kishan was down the track, and that may have left Prabh blinded. This length ball turned in towards his right shoulder, and he was beaten by the bounce. Another bye for SRH
much slower from Chahal. He teases Klaasen with this full and tossed up ball wide of off, and it turns away. Klaasen is beaten as he looks to drive. A bye for SRH
angling across, and quite full around eighth stump. Driven but off the inside edge to short fine leg
short of a length, and cut away to deep cover point

dropped again!! This time it's Ferguson. The bowler is Chahal again. How cruel can it get?! Ferguson was at fine leg, and the ball popped out of his hands as he looked to take it to his right. Kishan had swiped this length delivery, but ended up just falling short of the boundary
full ball on leg, and pushed to long-on
pulled in front of square, down to deep midwicket. Vyshak did well to bowl this outside Klaasen's arc.
waits and waits for this slower length ball to arrive as he pulls this down to wide long-on
rushed into the pull, the ball skews off the outer half of the bat to long-off
knuckleball on middle, pulled to deep square
pulled in front of square, no chance for Shedge running around the ropes at deep midwicket
punches this length ball on the up into the covers
rocks back and pulls one bounce to deep midwicket
slapped straight to cover

Shashank, again!  And it's not for the first time this season that he has put down an absolute dolly. Klaasen swept this high and straight down long leg's throat. Shashank not only dropped the catch but let the ball dribble to the boundary as well. Please don't look at Ponting to Shreyas.
steps out and swings this flat and hard to long-on. Saw him coming and tossed it wide
drifts in a tossed up delivery towards middle and leg, worked to long-on
there's more agony, this time for Yuzi who bowls a rank long hop. Klaasen muscles this pull to clear deep midwicket. 100 up for SRH
that's many a miles into the stands! Short and down leg, Kishan just swivelled around and used the pace to help it along into the top tier
looks to smash the cover off the ball as he tries to go over the off side, ends up getting a thick inside edge onto the pad
pulled to deep square leg
driven firmly to mid-off
short ball on the stumps, Klaasen gets besides the line and defends

what have you done, Cooper Connolly? Massive drop. This was pulled straight into his mitts at deep square. He got to the ball, and it's almost as if he had too much time. The ball bursts through his hands, but he somehow manages to save the boundary. But that's no consolation.
tucked to deep square leg, top over
squeezed off a thick inside edge to deep square

doesn't get to the pitch but goes through with the lofted hit and ends up miscuing it long-off, where Jansen moves a few steps to his left to take the skier. Well-disguised wrong'un from Chahal, got that to dip nicely on Head who was foxed by the length.
slides one quicker and across the left-hander, wide signalled as Head leaves
flatter one on leg-stump, worked to deep square
bowls a wrong'un on a length, slapped to long-off
punched into the gap at deep cover
pulled down to deep square leg, Connolly swiftly comes around
yorker-length on leg stump, flicked to deep square
clobbered down the ground, comfortably clears mid-off. Stayed deep inside the crease and got underneath the length to swing through.
slapped to deep point
that is massive! Hitting it on the rise. Just wow. Head stayed leg-side of the ball anticipating the short ball and swung for the hills to clear deep midwicket.
punched into the covers for a quick single
backs away and slaps this short of length delivery straight to mid-off
floats it full on middle, worked to mid-on for a single
drags this slower short of length ball from way outside off to mid-on for a quick single
slaughtered down the ground, over mid-off! Sat up nicely for Head to make room and swing cleanly.
ramped over the keeper's head! Jansen thought he'd bowled a superb bouncer, but ends up looking at the batter in utter disbelief.
slower bouncer outside off, but ends up bowling it way outside Head's hitting arc as he pulls and misses. Was way too early into the stroke
whips this length delivery straight to midwicket
beaten for pace, surprised by the bounce. Hit on the helmet as he looks to take on the short ball.
driven straight to mid-off
rises with the bounce and fends this bumper into the leg side

first wicket of the season for Lockie.  Abhishek looks to flat-bat this down town but ends up skewing it high to Shreyas at mid-off. That went a mile high. Enough time for any fielder to overthink. Nicely taken.
hooked over fine leg! Pacy short delivery on leg stump, and all Abhishek needed to do was get some bat on it. Which he did plenty of.
slants a short ball across Abhishek, left alone
bad ball, gift of a delivery. Tickled fine for four. Too easy.
full and straight, into the blockhole, squeezed to mid-off
there's more mayhem! My fingers hurt already. It's as if Head's brain is pre-programmed to pull anything short of a length tonight. Absolutely nails it, this time over deep midwicket.
take that! Another short ball on middle, Head swivels around in a jiffy to bludgeon this pull flat and over square leg
excellent bouncer on middle and leg, Head ducks under this one
beaten on the pull as this zips past. Wasn't all that short

even the mistimed ones go for four! But this was largely down to Connolly's poor effort at deep square. Abhishek ended up pulling, but getting a thickish inside edge into the gap. Should've been no more than two.
this one's a skiddy length ball that has Abhishek through with the pull way too early, and he gets hit on the midriff
spectacular stuff! Sat up nicely for Abhishek to flat-bat this back over the bowler's head. I suspect this was also a knuckleball. Landed poorly for Jansen.
the consequence of bowling full and getting whacked is to go short and into the body. And it's a good bumper, but Abhishek pulls and gets a top-edge to the fine leg fence.
launched over mid-off, for a second it felt like he'd got more height than distance. Nope, enough to comfortably clear the ropes.
hits hard length first up, this one comes in with the angle, Head gets an inside edge to the leg side
squeezed into the gap past the infield, down to deep cover point
flayed to deep point as he opens the bat face
slips one down leg, wide signalled as Head lets it pass
bunts this full toss to mid-off for a quick single
full and swinging away from off-stump, driven straight to cover
clean as a whistle! Lofted imperiously through the line to clear long-off. Nothing wrong with the delivery through.
full, nice curl away, Abhishek jams the yorker-length delivery to the off side
dot ball to end. SRH win by 33 runs. It may have been six had he connected. Slower and loopier from Shivang, who bowls this full and outside off. Connolly looks to heave across the line but misses
there's not a word from the Hyderabad crowd as this ball lands over long-off. Short in length, and outside off. He swats it with the turn away from him
loopy and full, and wide of off. Turns away, and is left alone
hundred for Connolly. His maiden T20 ton. A very Rishabh Pant way to get there. He falls on his back as he swivels to pull at this shortish ball outside off which turns in. Four over fine leg
full and wide of off, and left alone. It turns away, and is called wide
shorter side of a length on middle, and turning in. Clipped to deep midwicket for two hurried runs
just short of Sakib at short third. Full ball wide of off, and turning away. Vyshak had a jab at it, and got a top edge

sliced to cover point. That will keep Connolly away from the strike. Shivang gave the ball some air, and got it to dip on a full length outside off. The ball turned away, and Jansen mistimed his attempted no-look loft
six more!! Connolly moves into the 90s. Another full, fast and flat ball from Dubey, who bowls well outside off. Connolly fires it down the pitch for his seventh six
short again, and a little wide of off. Swatted back on the bounce to long-off
just beats the leaping fielder down the ground. Full and wide of Jansen, but the latter reaches out for a flat-batted six down the ground
fullish and quick on the stumps. Driven to long-on
inside edge... and the ball trickles for four. The ball is angled across, and is full and fast just outside off. Connolly forcefully swung at it, and beat short fine leg to his right
again on the bounce to deep midwicket. Dubey bowls from wide of the crease, and short outside off. Jansen has a pull at it
four between the keeper and short third. It was a high-ish full toss just outside off, and Connolly had a hard slash at it. The ball took off from the top edge
on the bounce to Abhishek at deep midwicket. Another no-look heave from Jansen, who targets this length delivery wide-ish of off
bouncer outside off, and Jansen ducks. The ball shapes in as he lets it go
through Sakib's hands!! Full ball well outside leg at just 104kph, and pushed back aerially. Single to long-on
skips down, and ends up getting a bottom edge as he looks to pull at this short ball outside leg which shapes away
low full toss just outside off. Driven to long-on
bowls really full, and very wide of off. Left alone by Jansen
short of a length, and just outside off. Keeps a little low, and is swiped to deep midwicket
quite full, and straight, as Malinga moves to pace on. Connolly swings to long-on
over deep midwicket!! A slower bouncer, but even that doesn't work. Connolly rolls his wrists to ride the bounce on middle, and crashes it for another six
bam!! Pings the base of the sightscreen. Malinga bowls another one at a lack of pace, but this is on a friendly, hittable length outside off. Connolly fires it back down the ground
short and wide of off. A slower one too, and swatted off the bottom of the bat towards square leg

Shivang drops this!! He was at deep midwicket, and had to keep his eyes on the ball for really long. But that's no excuse. He dropped the catch as the ball came to his right. Connolly sent that up a few hundred miles off a length, and survived

Abhishek runs and runs forward... but still falls short in the end. He was at deep midwicket and ran down, but the ball dropped to his right. Jansen played the no-look clip and went aerially off this length ball
superb bowling. Cummins bowls a yorker at 138kph on middle, and forces Connolly to go back and squeeze it out to cover
slower bouncer around seventh stump. Jansen has a helicopter swing at this pull to deep square leg
much fuller ball, and angling into the stumps. Drilled to long-off
this goes deeeep over deep midwicket. Short ball from Cummins around off, and Connolly thrashes it across by giving himself room
fires a yorker bang on middle, as the ball swings in. Jansen backs away and whips it to deep midwicket
another slower ball, and Connolly is beaten again. Full and slow on middle, and shaping away to finish outside off, as Connolly went across the line but missed

ohh, Connolly is hit on the box. He immediately goes down, and out comes the physio. It's going to be a break, so the umpires call for time-out. Amazing. It was another cutter from Sakib, who bowled on the shorter side of a length outside leg. Connolly looked to swing to the leg side but missed

dropped by Sakib!! He bangs the turf in frustration. Another slower ball from Sakib, who bowled this on a length just outside leg. Connolly went heaving but ended up ballooning it. Sakib turned around and ran forward, but missed he chance while reaching out
slow, full and wide of off. Jansen throws his bat at it, and ends up skying it towards long-off. Klaasen moves forward to collect the ball
this short-of-a-length ball keeps a little low. Pitched on middle and leg, and shaping away, and Connolly gets a bottom edge to short fine leg as he looks to pull
just short of Kishan!! Beaten by the lack of pace. Short in length, but an offcutter on leg. The ball shapes away, and takes the leading edge as Connolly looks to clip
change of pace, and Connolly plays one without any control. He aims for midwicket off this length delivery around middle and leg, but toe-ends it to long-off
this ball swings in, and arrives fullish on off. Flung away to deep midwicket off the inside half of the bat
another attempted yorker, bur this is a low full toss. The ball arrives on off, and is driven to deep cover point
lovely ball. A yorker just outside off at 140kph, as the ball tails away. Connolly looks to jam his bat at it but misses
ooh, Reddy is hobbling. He's at deep midwicket, and struggles to his left before cutting this ball off. It was a bouncer from Malinga, as Connolly pulled and raised his fifty
on a length on off, and with a scrambled seam. Connolly swats it back to Malinga's right. The bowler has a shy at the stumps but misses
a leave from Jansen... and wide not given. A lack of pace, and on a length. It's wide enough outside off for Jansen to let go, but not wide enough to be called wide
Sakib keeps going for the slower ones. This one is on a length on middle again, and Connolly finds Cummins at extra cover by pushing forward. Cummins aimed at Connolly's end, but just missed
short of a length, and just outside off. Punched to deep cover

taken at deep square leg. Reddy is out there at longer side of the ground. Shashank hit that hard and high, and my first impression was that it was going for six. Sakib bowled a short delivery around off which Shashank went pulling, but ended up finding Reddy
another one at a lack of pace. Connolly pushes forward at this length ball on the stumps, and Cummins from extra cover slides to his left to keep this to one
wow, brilliant timing. He waits and waits for this slower delivery to come at him on a length in and around off, and plays the late slash to deep third
slower bouncer again. Not called wide, and Shashank ponders. He doesn't review, though. The ball was wide-ish of off, and he leapt while looking to slash but missed
four first ball. That was hit aerially, but well wide of mid-off. A length delivery from Cummins just outside off, and Shashank lofts from deep in the crease

well taken by Abhishek!! What a contrast between the two teams' catching today. Abhishek is at deep midwicket, and runs in considerably to take a sliding catch. Cummins bowls a cutter - a slower bouncer, in fact - and Shedge goes for the pull. But the ball takes off from the top half of the bat, as Cummins gets some extra bounce
mid-off is inside the circle, and Shedge can't beat him. He leans into this push off this length ball just outside off. Two dots out of three so far
almost like a sliced pull from Connolly. Slower ball, and a bouncer around seventh stump. Connolly reads the lack of pace and gets on top of the bounce for a single to deep midwicket
angled in, and a yorker on middle. Jammed back to Cummins
that is 18 off the over!! PBKS have piled up 35 off the last two overs. Short delivery on middle, and turning away. Shedge is deep in the crease, and rams it over long-on
ohh, he had a hard swing at it, but mistimed the ball. Full and slower on off from Shivang, and the ball is dragged to midwicket
very full, and around sixth stump. Driven to deep cover point
a bit fuller, and outside off. Cut away to deep cover
misfield from Abhishek. He's at long-off, moves to his left, and misses the ball which Shedge had swatted off a shortish length
flung over long-off!! A freely lofted shot off a length ball outside off. Good start to the over for PBKS
yorker-length outside off, looks to jam his bat down to squeeze it past short third but is beaten
this is even better! Dubey goes fuller, and Connolly swings through like a golfer. Hit that hard and really far.
that's sent into the second-tier. Dubey fires this in but also ends up dropping short, Connolly lines him up as he waits inside the crease and swings through the line to clear deep midwicket
heaved towards deep midwicket
swung hard, no timing. One bounce to long-on
tosses one up but once again outside the wide line as Connolly leaves
beaten as he looks to cut, wide signalled
works this with the angle towards midwicket
cuts straight to point
another wrong'un, squared up a hint but manages to steer this behind square on the off side
pushed through quicker as he angles one across, tapped to short third
heaves this one away to deep midwicket, no timing
tossed up nicely on middle, driven to sweeper cover
shapes to pull but this keeps a tad low, toe-ends it past square leg
walks across to whip this to midwicket
pulled in front of square, Klaasen's patrolling the boundary at deep midwicket
dabs it gently down to third man
whips this down to deep midwicket
taps it gently wide of point for a single
steered straight to point
pushes this skiddy length ball on off to cover
pushed to deep cover to get off the mark

taken on the second attempt! Not a ball that had 'wicket' written on it, but he still has one. Stoinis looks to give this a proper thrashing but this wrong'un considerably slowed down and took an age to get to him as the thick edge is pouched by Kishan.
goes flatter and across, beaten as he attempts a cut
drilled through extra cover! Too full from Shivang, drifting away and right into the slot for the stroke. Superb timing.
paddled round the corner towards fine leg
full on leg-stump, Connolly squeezes this to the off side
drives this slower and fuller delivery straight to cover
sways out of the way of this short ball angling away
yorker-length, tails away to beat Connolly's outside edge as he tries to scythe this behind point.
bails out of a short ball that sails way over his head, wide called
sat up nicely as Connolly pulls in front of square, picks the gap at deep square to perfection.
throws his hands at that as there's width and he slices this behind point for four.
bowls on the pads and this has been flicked over fine leg for six. Easy pickings. Simply helped that along. 19 off Sakib's first over.
looks for a change up, but ends up looping a full toss outside off. It's also above waist height, but Stoinis manages to reach this as he puts it away to the cover boundary. Free-hit coming up.
bowls a cutter but loses his radar, too far wide outside off.
that's been smashed in front of square, bullets to the point boundary. Both feet off the ground as he made contact. Used the width to slap that powerfully.
shows the full face as he defends back
just short of the cover fielder, but it slips past him and they get a couple. Should've been stopped nonetheless by Smaran
squared up a hint by the length but manages to get behind the line in defence
width outside off, flayed to square third man
mistimes this slower length ball to mid-on
muscled over wide long-on! This one was floated up nicely and Stoinis had the width to swing through cleanly.
gets s leading edge, luckily for him it doesn't go to the bowler's hand on the followthrough
bunts this length delivery to mid-on

is that the game?  Shreyas has picked out his opposite number at mid-off! Looks to go down town but the bat face turns in his hand. Malinga goes hard length so he also hits this very high on the bat, simple catch to the skipper. Malinga is ecstatic, PBKS not so much.
works this incoming length delivery to mid-on
squeezes this yorker-length delivery to point
hustled for pace, defended back to the leg side

fetch that from the stands! Makes room and swings for the hills, gets enough height on it as this slap sails over deep cover. Didn't get hold of it but still managed to get six. Must be a seriously good willow.
hit on the body as he's early into the pull. Cummins oversteps, and will now have to counter a free-hit.
hard length on off, pushed back towards mid-off
punched on the up, cover point seemed to get a hand on it to take pace off. Well covered by NKR running around from square third
uses the width to flay this on the up over cover point. Superb hand-eye coordination there.
mistimes this off a thick inside edge to mid-on for a quick single
play and a miss. Length slanting across, beaten as he looks to thrash this on the up
steered wide of point for a single
swinging away from outside off, driven straight to cover
what a way to get off the mark. Too much width and Shreyas disdainfully slaps this in front of point

make that two in two! PBKS are in early strife.  Nitish floats one a touch fuller, the ball curls away a hint and Prabhsimran ends up getting a leading edge that loops high towards backward point. Cummins called for it, covered good ground to his left from cover and tumbled around to complete the catch.

what a moment that! Malinga was strategically placed on the boundary at deep square and  Priyansh Arya has fallen to the trap.  This is an excellent short delivery that's angled across, Arya has to fetch it from quite some way outside off, he ends up hitting it well but perhaps didn't account for the fielder patrolling the boundary. Cummins has his arms aloft, seemingly suggesting he was merely playing to the plan all along.
